title: A Discord reply that fails part way posts an error under half an answer and the turn is never stored; a second message within 3 s is dropped silently
evidence: Survey 2026-11-12 (main 5187412d5); Fable ruled 2026-11-12: app/lib/discord-bot.server.ts chunk sends inside the try, persistConversation after the loop, checkUserCooldown. The half-answer part is done: PR 1367 (f8b62c581) and PR 1416 store a cut-off answer as sent and send fixed words only when nothing went out (US-15 AC62; discord-bot.server.ts:349-357). Still open: the 3 s cooldown drops a second message with no reply (discord-bot.server.ts:235)
